title: Move payment terms to their own module
prompts:
Refactor ledgerkit: the payment-terms logic lives among the general date helpers. Move `termsDays` (with its terms table) and `dueDateFor` into a new module `src/terms.js`.

The date module keeps only date helpers and must not export or re-export the two functions any more. Every module that used them, and any test that imports them, must import them from `src/terms.js`. The package's public exports (the index) stay exactly as they are, `dueDateFor` included, and behaviour does not change.

Run the whole suite when you're done.
notes: P4 move. Importers of the moved functions are spread over customer.js, invoice.js, index.js and test/dates.test.js; the dates module itself loses them. The prompt names only the new module. The hidden suite scans every src file's imports so a lingering re-export or import from the dates module fails, and pins the index's export list. hidden/test/dates.test.js is the visible one with its imports updated. The reference touches src/dates.js, src/terms.js (new), src/customer.js, src/invoice.js, src/index.js and test/dates.test.js.
